question: What does "craftsmanship" mean in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3) Skill in making things**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"craftsmanship"** means the quality and skill involved in making something, especially with care and artistry. (कौशल/हुनर)

 
 
• **Example:** The craftsmanship of the handwoven saree impressed everyone at the exhibition.
 
 
 
• **"Skill in making things"** refers to the ability to create or produce objects with expertise and precision. (चीजें बनाने का कौशल)
 
 
• **Example:** His skill in making wooden furniture shows true dedication to his craft.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the passage, "craftsmanship" clearly refers to **skill in making things**, highlighting the artistry of traditional Indian clothing.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3) Skill in making things**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Poor quality** (खराब गुणवत्ता): Refers to something that is not well-made or lacks standard.

 
 
• **Example:** The poor quality of the fabric made the dress look cheap.
 
 
 
• **Traditional dance** (पारंपरिक नृत्य): Refers to cultural or folk dances passed down through generations.
 
 
• **Example:** Bharatanatyam is a famous traditional dance of Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Imported materials** (आयातित सामग्री): Refers to goods or raw materials brought from another country.
 
 
• **Example:** The company uses imported materials to manufacture luxury handbags.
